rules: Fields that take vocabulary ids must use an id from this file. If nothing fits, use the closest id AND add an entry to proposed_new_terms; never invent ids.
Labels use Chabad/Ashkenazi transliteration (see transliteration). Aliases are search synonyms and known ASR misspellings; they are never displayed.
Hierarchy: topics have parents; people have categories. Tag the most specific id; the site rolls up to parents.
Entries marked "unconfirmed": true are placeholders (DECISIONS 3). Use them as ids, never present a guess as fact in public fields; record guesses in identity_guesses.
Entries marked "deprecated": true must not be used; use the id in use_instead.
changes: 0.3 (2026-11-25): pass-2 merge added 54 entries (people 32, calendar 12, works 3, mitzvos 4, midos 2, series 1); see pass2/vocab.json and PASS2_REPORT.md.

transliteration.style: Chabad/Ashkenazi: sav = s (Shabbos, Sukkos, mitzvos), ches/chaf = ch, tzadi = tz, plural -os/-im, Rebbe titles as used in Chabad.
transliteration.display_titles: Title Case English; keep Hebrew/Yiddish terms in the preferred spelling (e.g. "The Baal Shem Tov and the Kidnapped Boy", not "Besht to the Rescue" if the filename is an abbreviation). Keep the filename title as an alias.
transliteration.yiddish_titles: title_he keeps the Hebrew-script title as written (no nikud); title_translit uses YIVO-like romanization for Yiddish words and the Chabad style above for loshn-koydesh words.

content_type.label: Radio episode
content_type.description: A full broadcast (about 30 min) of a radio program.

content_type.label: Radio segment
content_type.description: A clip cut from a radio episode: a talk, a story, a song, an activity.

content_type.label: Story
content_type.description: One complete story (may include a short intro and lesson).

content_type.label: Story chapter
content_type.description: One chapter of a serial story; not complete on its own.

content_type.label: Story collection
content_type.description: Several distinct stories in one recording (use segments).

content_type.label: Talk
content_type.description: A short teaching on a holiday, midah, mitzvah or parsha, without a main story.

content_type.label: Lesson with story
content_type.description: A teaching (halachah, holiday, sichah) with one or more stories woven in.

content_type.label: Shiur (class)
content_type.description: A study class on a text (Tanya, Shulchan Aruch HaRav, Haggadah) for older listeners.

content_type.label: Live event
content_type.description: Rally, farbrengen or class recorded live with an audience.

content_type.label: Fragment
content_type.description: Too short or incomplete to stand alone.

story_type.label: Chassidic story
story_type.description: Baal Shem Tov, Rebbeim, tzaddikim and their Chassidim.

story_type.label: Great rabbis of later generations
story_type.description: Rashi, Rambam, Arizal, Ohr HaChayim, etc. (non-Chassidic).

story_type.label: Historical tale
story_type.description: Set in a specific period/place, e.g. Baghdad, Czarist Russia.

story_type.label: Mashal / parable
story_type.description: Allegory or parable told to make a point.

story_type.label: Contemporary / true-life
story_type.description: Modern events, first-person miracle stories, recent Chassidim.

story_type.label: Moral tale
story_type.description: Fictional children's story built around a lesson.

segment_type.label: Announcements (candle time, campaigns, birthdays, refuah shleimah)
